# Nexnify — Website & Web Application Development Studio

> This file follows the llms.txt specification to help AI language models and
> search engines accurately understand and represent Nexnify's services.
> Information here reflects the publicly available content on nexnify.in.

## About Nexnify

Nexnify is an independent website and web application development studio based
in Delhi NCR, India. The studio builds fast, responsive, conversion-focused
websites and web applications for businesses, startups, and brands.

Nexnify works directly with business owners — no account managers, no
subcontracting. Every project is handled by the core technical team from
discovery to deployment.

## Core Services

- **Business Website Development** — Custom-designed, mobile-first responsive
  websites for businesses, consultancies, and corporate brands. Built with
  Next.js, React, and clean semantic HTML. Includes structured data, WhatsApp
  lead funnels, and Core Web Vitals optimization.

- **Next.js & React Development** — High-performance web applications built on
  Next.js App Router architecture. Suitable for SaaS platforms, booking portals,
  dashboards, and content-heavy sites requiring fast page loads.

- **WordPress Development** — Professional WordPress website builds for
  institutions, coaching academies, blogs, and businesses that need a CMS.
  Custom themes, ACF integration, and performance optimization.

- **Custom Web Application Development** — Full-stack web applications with PHP,
  MySQL, and modern JavaScript. Includes travel portals, booking engines,
  institutional management systems, and custom admin dashboards.

- **Landing Page Design & Development** — High-converting single-page designs
  for product launches, lead generation campaigns, and marketing funnels.

- **Website Redesign & Performance Optimization** — Rebuilding outdated or
  slow-performing websites with modern architecture, improved Core Web Vitals
  scores, and mobile responsiveness.

- **Website Maintenance & Annual Care Plans** — Ongoing support, security
  updates, content changes, and performance monitoring for existing websites.

## Portfolio (Selected Real Projects)

- **AuraLux Residences** — Luxury serviced residence portal built with Next.js
  15 App Router. Improved mobile PageSpeed from 38 to 99/100 and increased
  direct inquiries. Live at auraluxresidences.com.

- **Aura Bridal Studio** — Luxury bridal makeup and destination wedding portal.
  Includes interactive wedding date reservation, WhatsApp concierge routing,
  and BeautySalon Schema. Live at aurabridalstudio.com.

- **SkyOdeals Travel Portal** — Custom flight and travel booking platform built
  with PHP, MySQL, and vanilla JavaScript. Reduced multi-city flight search
  response from 4.8s to 0.6s.

- **HIT IAS Academy** — Institutional coaching academy website built on
  WordPress with custom theme, landing pages, and lead capture forms.

- **Pactiva Energy Solutions** — Corporate energy consulting website with
  modern design and service showcase.

- **XChat** — Custom chat application interface.
